title: Original Xbox Wireless Pelican Eclipse Adapter Dongle Only PL-2020 No Controller
categoryName: Video Games & Consoles:Video Game Accessories:Controllers & Attachments
descriptionText:
This Pelican Eclipse Adapter Dongle is the perfect addition to your original Xbox wireless controller. It allows for seamless connectivity and maximum performance while gaming. The black plastic material and sleek design make it a stylish addition to your gaming setup. 

With this adapter, you can enjoy your favorite games with ease, and the wireless connectivity ensures you can play without any hindrance. It is compatible with Microsoft Xbox and comes with a maximum number of players of one. The adapter does not come with a controller, but it is compatible with most controllers. Get your hands on this amazing adapter today and take your gaming experience to the next level!
